review.note: Retrospective coordinator manifest for the accepted PRFIX-114f fix round. reviewFindingsSha256 hashes .orchestration/reports/proofs-wave/forecast-a3f80d13.md, also preserved at .orchestration/merge-records/evidence/PR-WAVE-proofs/forecast-a3f80d13.md. The two source findings name custom probe legs, not framework test cases; therefore both finding-level tests and the top-level protected tests are empty. The probe behavior was checked manually in the recorded probe runs, but the framework test guard cannot protect those legs.

findings.comment: PR #114 forecast: concurrent multipart completions could overwrite orig/<sha> with bytes that do not hash to the key after the first caller succeeds.
findings.text: Two multipart completions pass head concurrently; the second can overwrite orig/<sha> with bytes that do not hash to its key after the first caller succeeds. The synthetic Bun binding probe returned 200 for both calls and the second caller's bytes won.

findings.comment: PR #114 forecast: a restore step or finish can pass removedCase before removal completes, then write storage after removal and leave residue skipped by later reconciliation.
findings.text: A restore step or finish passes removedCase, then removal completes; a later storage write can leave case rows or objects behind while erased_at causes later reconciliation to skip them. The source forecast had not probed this finding; it was reproduced by a custom recovery probe during the fix round.
